evidence_cards.content: Common tracking is defined as sharing of a common track number and shifting R² between C² JUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the high-level objective (goal) of the use case: to enable shared tracking responsibility among C² JUs by transferring reporting authority while maintaining a unified track identifier.

evidence_cards.content: The goal of the use case is to ensure continuity of reporting when a subsurface contact is frequently lost/regained, and to allow comparison of different JUs' data to localize and identify contacts.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly states the high-level objective that the primary actor (C2 JU) wants to achieve through transfer of reporting responsibility for subsurface tracks.

evidence_cards.content: The unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.7.2 ELECTRONIC WARFARE PRODUCT INFORMATION REPORTING RESPONSIBILITY

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement defines the goal of retaining reporting responsibility for the originating unit (C2 JU), which is the primary objective regarding transfer of responsibility discussed in this section.

evidence_cards.content: The transferring C2 JU currently holds R² for a track that is to be transferred.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes the required system state before the use case can begin: one C2 JU must already possess reporting responsibility (R²) for the track in order to transfer it. Without this precondition, there is no R² to shift.

evidence_cards.content: A JU currently holds Reporting Responsibility ($R^2$) for a track and retains this responsibility until it is relinquished according to specific rules.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the mandatory initial state for the Primary Actor (the transferring C2 JU) before the transfer can begin.

evidence_cards.content: Reporting Responsibility is relinquished by a JU upon reception of a remote track report where the remote Track Quality (TQ) is greater than the local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a critical system state condition (Remote TQ > Local TQ) that must hold for the transfer of responsibility to be triggered/accepted.

evidence_cards.content: Reporting Responsibility is also relinquished upon reception of a remote track report where the remote TQ is equal to the local TQ, provided the remote Station Number (STN) is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative system state condition (Remote TQ = Local TQ AND Remote STN > Local STN) required for the transfer logic.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs capable of assuming R² for air, surface, or land tracks shall not transmit those tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that before a C2 JU can assume reporting responsibility (R²) — which is the target state after transfer — it must complete internal validation steps; this implies the receiving system must be in a ready state to perform these checks prior to accepting R².

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines mandatory time-based preconditions that must elapse after achieving Active status before track transmission (and thus R² assumption) can occur — directly constraining when the use case can begin if the receiving JU has recently become active.

evidence_cards.content: The first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility (R²) for that Track Number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the initial state where one C2 JU holds R² for a track, which is a necessary precondition before any transfer of that responsibility can occur.

evidence_cards.content: The transferring C2 JU must currently hold R² for the track to be transferred.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes that a JU with R² on a track retains responsibility until relinquished per specific rules or dropped, implying that holding R² is a necessary precondition before any transfer can occur.

evidence_cards.content: For real-time tracks, the receiving JU must not have already received a remote report with TQ greater than local TQ (which would cause automatic relinquishment), and if TQ is equal, the source TN of the remote JU must be greater than local Source TN for relinquishment to occur — thus, prior to transfer, these conditions must NOT yet hold for the current holder to retain R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These define state constraints under which R² is retained; therefore, for a voluntary transfer to proceed, the system must be in a state where none of these automatic relinquishment triggers have occurred — making them implicit preconditions for controlled transfer.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU assumes R² of an IU (including C2 and nonC2 JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data when: a. A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, or b. A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, or c. A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, or d. The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These conditions constitute the explicit triggers under which a C2 JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) for an Interface Unit (IU), directly defining the events that initiate the transfer of reporting responsibility use case.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an automatic trigger condition under which reporting responsibility shifts — specifically, timeout-based assumption of R² by the receiving JU when no remote update is received within specified time thresholds. This constitutes a system-initiated trigger event for transfer of reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Receipt of a J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track message triggers the receiving JU to assume R², provided eligibility conditions are met — this is a direct protocol-triggered event initiating transfer of reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to value 0 shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Local update of a nonreal-time track with TQ=0 triggers automatic assumption of R² by the updating JU — this is a data-update-triggered event for transferring reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J2 PPLI message (with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that has R² of a locally held track, may assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Reception of a J2 PPLI message with specific NPS indicators from an R²-holding JU triggers potential assumption of R² by the receiver — this is a message-type-and-status-triggered event for transfer initiation.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an external event (receiving a J7.0 drop track message) that triggers the automatic assumption of reporting responsibility (R²), serving as a specific trigger condition for the transfer use case.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track... shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a local data update event as a trigger for assuming reporting responsibility in the context of nonreal-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A surveillance JU will accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and perform the applicable correlation and conflict processing necessary to ensure that duplicative information is not being transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the initiating action of the receiving C2 JU in the main flow: accepting PPLI data and performing correlation/conflict resolution to avoid redundancy — a foundational step in transferring reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C² JU has R², the J7.2 Correlation message shall be transmitted with the Response Value (RV) field set to value 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), and with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN. The C² JU shall cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the canonical success scenario where the current R² holder (C² JU) detects correlation with incoming PPLI, retains its own track number, drops the redundant one, and formally relinquishes reporting via J7.0 — completing the transfer of responsibility while preserving common track identity.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative successful path where the receiving C² JU assumes R² by retaining the source TN from the PPLI message and dropping its local TN — still achieving the goal of shifting R² while maintaining a shared track context through explicit TN selection.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the TNs are the same, the JU receiving the J2 shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Handles the case where both JUs share the same TN; the receiver accepts PPLI data and suppresses local J3 reporting unless quality is degraded — ensuring continuity of reporting under shared identity without altering TN assignment, thus fulfilling the use case’s requirement to retain common track number during R² shift.

evidence_cards.content: Common tracking is defined as sharing of a common track number and shifting R² between C² JUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the core interaction sequence for transferring reporting responsibility while maintaining shared track identity — directly maps to main_flow steps: share track number, shift R².

evidence_cards.content: Each air, surface (maritime), land (ground), and space tracked object normally will be reported by one C² JU while other C² JUs withhold their reports to prevent cluttering the tactical plot.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the normal operational state before transfer: only one JU reports; others suppress — this is the baseline condition under which R² shifting occurs in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: Determination of the C² JU responsible for reporting the tracked object shall be in accordance with the procedures in the Air, Surface, Land, and Space Surveillance sections.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies that the selection of which JU assumes reporting responsibility after R² shift follows predefined domain-specific procedures — part of the canonical success scenario’s governance logic.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action in the main flow where the receiving C2 JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) following a trigger event.

evidence_cards.content: Immediately prior to assuming R² for an air or surface track after receipt of a Drop Track message, a JU shall test the track for correlation in accordance with paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and g, except the test shall be conducted only once.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory validation step (correlation test) required within the main flow sequence before assuming responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the automatic step in the main flow where reporting responsibility is transferred due to superior track quality data from another unit.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all the above rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the tie-breaking rule in the main flow for transferring reporting responsibility when track quality values are identical.

evidence_cards.content: When another JU assumes R² for a track, it shall transmit the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND which was received in previous J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mandatory action (transmitting specific alert indicators) that the new R² holder must perform immediately after assuming responsibility, constituting a key step in the main flow of the transfer.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found between the received J2 PPLI report and local data, the C² JU integrates the PPLI into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture; if no subsequent J2 messages are received and the C² JU still has no local data, it assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative successful path where the receiving C² JU does not correlate the incoming PPLI with local data (diverging from main flow step 2), yet still processes the data without assuming R² — a valid variant that avoids duplicate or erroneous reporting while maintaining system integrity.

evidence_cards.content: If position or other data in a PPLI meet a system’s decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated; after decorrelation, the C² JU initiates a new surveillance track report using a new track number, and reports both the PPLI Track Number/Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field as 'No Statement'.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines another alternative flow: when correlation fails due to decorrelation criteria being met, the system diverges from retaining the common track number (main flow step 2) by creating a new track with modified identity fields — still a successful outcome within the broader reporting framework, though outside the scope of R² transfer for shared tracks.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict; (2) The two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local Mode II code is current; (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data; or (4) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section defines specific constraints on automatic correlation that would prevent the standard merging of tracks in the main flow. These restrictions act as alternative logic paths where the system must inhibit automatic correlation, diverging from the standard 'successful' correlation assumed in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The automatic correlation restrictions do not apply to manual correlation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a valid alternative path (manual intervention) for handling tracks that fail automatic correlation tests due to ID conflicts, Mode II differences, or other restrictions listed in paragraph g.

evidence_cards.content: If the transferring C2 JU (own unit) holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, the Retained TN shall be designated as a common local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative disposition for the dropped track number where the transferred track is retained locally rather than being dropped remotely, diverging from the main flow of transmitting a J7.0 drop message.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds, or on a locally held Land (Ground) track for approximately 120 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the receiving C2 JU assumes reporting responsibility based on a timeout trigger rather than a specific message receipt.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track with the TQ field set to value 0 shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow for assuming reporting responsibility triggered by local updates of nonreal-time tracks with low quality data, diverging from standard PPLI-based triggers.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative path where the current R² holder automatically loses responsibility due to receiving superior data (higher TQ) from another unit, diverging from the main flow of voluntary transfer via J7.0 message.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all other rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a secondary automatic relinquishment condition based on Source TN priority when TQ values are equal, representing another variant path for losing reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R² on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with transmit/receive rules.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific exception/alternative behavior for Ballistic Missile tracks where the transfer of R² for the missile does not necessarily force the transfer of R² for the associated launch point, allowing split responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: Differences in Environment/Category, ID, Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, Exercise Indicator and Special Interest Indicator field values may also be resolved with the use of the J7.0 (ACT = 2) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative mechanism for resolving data differences during track transfer — specifically using a Change Data Order message instead of relying solely on PPLI or Drop Track messages — which constitutes a legal alternative path diverging from the main flow’s reliance on J7.0 (ACT=0) or J2 PPLI for R² shift.

evidence_cards.content: When accepting a remote ID change, C² JUs shall retain received values of Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields (where implemented) for retransmission and operator appreciation, except under specific conditions: (a) controlling units follow paragraphs 4.7.1.2.2b and c; (b) when Platform/Activity/Type value is 0 locally held non-zero; (c) when Air Platform values 6,7,8 are held locally and different value received (operator alert optional).

source_locations.location: Section 4.7.1.2.4 PLATFORM/PLATFORM ACTIVITY/SPECIFIC TYPE AND SPECIAL INTEREST INDICATOR DIFFERENCE RESOLUTION

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines exceptions to standard difference resolution behavior during R² transfer — these represent controlled deviations from the canonical success scenario where field retention rules are modified based on local state or unit type, thus qualifying as alternative flows that still result in successful transfer.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the TNs are different, the receiving C² JU transmits a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message, retaining the Source TN from the J2 PPLI Header as the Retained TN and dropping the surveillance TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exception handling path when correlation succeeds but Track Numbers differ, specifying the exact messaging protocol to resolve the conflict without assuming reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with Interface Units (IUs).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a hard constraint that prevents the transfer of reporting responsibility via correlation for subsurface tracks, acting as an exclusionary rule for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: Automatic correlation is restricted (and thus R² transfer via automatic correlation fails) if: (1) the two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference constituting a conflict; (2) the two tracks have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current; (3) both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks being updated with local positional data; or (4) either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1. These restrictions do not apply to manual correlation, which may be used as an exit path to establish common tracking despite these conditions.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines explicit exception conditions that block automatic correlation — a prerequisite for successful R² transfer in the main flow — and specifies manual correlation as the alternative resolution path, satisfying the requirement for trigger condition AND exit path in exception_flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J2 PPLI message (with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that has R² of a locally held track may assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception/alternative path where the standard PPLI trigger is modified by specific status indicators (Inactive, Radio Silence, TDS Failure), allowing the receiving JU to assume responsibility under these degraded conditions.

evidence_cards.content: Immediately prior to assuming R² for an air or surface track after receipt of a Drop Track message, a JU shall test the track for correlation in accordance with paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and g, except the test shall be conducted only once.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a constrained exception flow for the correlation step: while normally repeated, this test is performed exactly once when triggered by a Drop Track message before assuming responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: Differences in ballistic missile position or velocity recognized by a JU are not resolved through conflict processing and shall not generate a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 1, Difference Report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition where expected conflict resolution (via J7.0 ACT=1) is explicitly prohibited for ballistic missile position/velocity differences — this constitutes an exception flow that diverges from standard difference-handling procedures during R² transfer context.

evidence_cards.content: There may be cases when a system does not receive a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, and receives no further updates on the remote ballistic missile track; each system should have the capability to automatically purge those tracks after a specific time interval (system-selected parameter).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception scenario where the expected termination signal (J7.0 ACT=0) is missing, triggering an automatic purge mechanism instead of normal relinquishment — this is an error/unexpected condition handling path relevant to exception_flow.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU rejecting the requested correlation holds the Dropped TN but not the Retained TN (and the Dropped TN has an OCC), it executes specific actions based on the RV field: if RV is 0, transmit a reverse correlation with RV set to 1; if RV is 1, transmit a correlation rejection with RV set to 2; if RV is 3, execute the correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines exception handling for correlation requests when the receiving unit lacks the Retained TN but holds the Dropped TN, specifying distinct recovery paths (reverse correlation, rejection, or forced execution) based on the RV value.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU rejecting the requested correlation holds the Dropped TN but not the Retained TN, and the Dropped TN does not have an OCC, the unit shall execute the correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides an alternative exception path for the 'Retained TN not held' scenario where the Dropped TN lacks an OCC, mandating immediate correlation execution rather than message exchange.

evidence_cards.content: If a C2 JU rejecting a J7.2 message holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, it shall not interpret the J7.2 message as a Drop Track message for the purpose of determining R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Prevents incorrect state transitions (R² determination) during exception conditions where a rejection message might otherwise be misinterpreted as a drop command.

evidence_cards.content: If a received J7.2 message contains one or both of the same TNs as contained in the transmission of the own unit's J7.2 message sequence in progress, specific actions shall be taken (details follow on next page).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a collision/loop condition where a unit receives its own TNs during an active message sequence, triggering a specific exception handling routine.

evidence_cards.content: If a received J7.2 message contains one or both of the same TNs as contained in the transmission of the own unit's J7.2 message sequence in progress, the JU performs the prescribed specific actions; exit path: follow the prescribed J7.2 collision-handling routine and do not proceed with the R² shift until the collision is resolved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This directly addresses the exception_flow slot by specifying the trigger condition (J7.2 message with conflicting TNs) and the explicit exit path (follow collision-handling routine, pause R² shift), resolving the inconsistency about what happens after such a collision during an R² transfer attempt.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This rule defines the specific exception handling path when a 'Drop Track' message is received: rather than dropping the track or terminating the transfer, the receiving JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²), ensuring continuity of the shared track number.

evidence_cards.content: Immediately prior to assuming R² for an air or surface track after receipt of a Drop Track message, a JU shall test the track for correlation in accordance with paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and g, except the test shall be conducted only once.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim specifies the mandatory validation step (correlation test) required as part of the exception flow triggered by the Drop Track message, distinguishing it from standard correlation procedures.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides the specific exit path for the exception flow regarding the resolution of a J7.2 same-track-number collision: once the collision is resolved and the Drop Track message is processed, the system proceeds to assume R², effectively continuing from the step where responsibility is assumed (Main Flow Step 5).

evidence_cards.content: When another JU assumes R² for a track, it shall transmit the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND which was received in previous J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim defines the specific recovery action (transmitting previously received alert indicators) required after an R² assumption event, serving as the continuation path for exception flows where R² is assumed by a new unit (e.g., following a collision resolution or transfer failure).

evidence_cards.content: If the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held, and the Dropped TN has an OCC: if RV is set to 0, transmit a reverse correlation with RV set to 1; if RV is set to 1, transmit a correlation rejection with RV set to 2; if RV is set to 3, execute the correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines specific exception handling paths for rejecting a correlation request when the JU holds the Dropped TN but not the Retained TN, depending on the RV field value.

evidence_cards.content: If the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held, and the Dropped TN does not have an OCC, execute the correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception handling path for processing a correlation request when the Dropped TN lacks an OCC, bypassing standard rejection logic.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs rejecting a J7.2 message and holding the Dropped TN as a local or common local track shall not interpret the J7.2 message as a Drop Track message for the purpose of determining R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an exception condition where a J7.2 message must not be interpreted as a drop track command, preventing erroneous R² determination.

evidence_cards.content: If the received J7.2 message contains one or both of the same TNs as contained in the transmission of the own unit J7.2 message sequence in progress, specific actions shall be taken based on the own unit RV field value (0, 1, or 3 leads to discontinuing transmission and processing the received message; value 2 leads to completing the transmission in progress).
